# keys.toml: keys: what a body presses rather than types, and what that costs
# Written by cargo test -p aralo-core --test golden. Do not edit; bless it.
# Expanded at 2026-03-09 14:05:07 +01:00. | is the caret, [] a selection.

=== a tab between two fields fills a form out
--- en_US
field: "Dana Ruiz\tdana@acme.example|"
preview: "\t"
undo: not by backspace
--- de_DE
field: "Dana Ruiz\tdana@acme.example|"
preview: "\t"
undo: not by backspace
--- ja_JP
field: "Dana Ruiz\tdana@acme.example|"
preview: "\t"
undo: not by backspace

=== a return goes back as a key, so backspace cannot take it back
--- en_US
field: "Subject\nBody|"
preview: "Subject\nBody"
undo: not by backspace
--- de_DE
field: "Subject\nBody|"
preview: "Subject\nBody"
undo: not by backspace
--- ja_JP
field: "Subject\nBody|"
preview: "Subject\nBody"
undo: not by backspace

=== enter is another spelling of return
--- en_US
field: "One\nTwo|"
preview: "One\nTwo"
undo: not by backspace
--- de_DE
field: "One\nTwo|"
preview: "One\nTwo"
undo: not by backspace
--- ja_JP
field: "One\nTwo|"
preview: "One\nTwo"
undo: not by backspace

=== a key at the start presses before anything is typed
--- en_US
field: "\tDana|"
preview: "\tDana"
undo: not by backspace
--- de_DE
field: "\tDana|"
preview: "\tDana"
undo: not by backspace
--- ja_JP
field: "\tDana|"
preview: "\tDana"
undo: not by backspace

=== a key Aralo cannot press stays as written
--- en_US
field: "Go {{key: left}} one.|"
preview: "Go {{key: left}} one."
undo: 21 backspaces
note: "Aralo can press Tab and Return, not left, so this stays as written."
--- de_DE
field: "Go {{key: left}} one.|"
preview: "Go {{key: left}} one."
undo: 21 backspaces
note: "Aralo can press Tab and Return, not left, so this stays as written."
--- ja_JP
field: "Go {{key: left}} one.|"
preview: "Go {{key: left}} one."
undo: 21 backspaces
note: "Aralo can press Tab and Return, not left, so this stays as written."

=== a key with nothing named says which keys there are
--- en_US
field: "Go {{key}} on.|"
preview: "Go {{key}} on."
undo: 14 backspaces
note: "Write {{key: tab}} or {{key: return}}: those are the keys Aralo can press."
--- de_DE
field: "Go {{key}} on.|"
preview: "Go {{key}} on."
undo: 14 backspaces
note: "Write {{key: tab}} or {{key: return}}: those are the keys Aralo can press."
--- ja_JP
field: "Go {{key}} on.|"
preview: "Go {{key}} on."
undo: 14 backspaces
note: "Write {{key: tab}} or {{key: return}}: those are the keys Aralo can press."

=== a cursor stop counts the key it moves back over
--- en_US
field: "|Name\tEmail"
preview: "Name\tEmail"
undo: not by backspace
--- de_DE
field: "|Name\tEmail"
preview: "Name\tEmail"
undo: not by backspace
--- ja_JP
field: "|Name\tEmail"
preview: "Name\tEmail"
undo: not by backspace

=== the case the abbreviation was typed in reaches across a key
--- en_US
field: "NAME\tEMAIL |"
preview: "name\temail"
undo: not by backspace
--- de_DE
field: "NAME\tEMAIL |"
preview: "name\temail"
undo: not by backspace
--- ja_JP
field: "NAME\tEMAIL |"
preview: "name\temail"
undo: not by backspace
